_description: Phase 2 agentic activity evidence bundle. Synthetic telemetry derived from the agent-security-lab workflow. No secrets, credentials, cookies, tokens, or real customer data are present. All timestamps are representative ISO 8601 UTC values.
_derivable_from: Audit log lines emitted by authorization_policy.check_authorization() and each gateway (publish_gateway.py, read_gateway.py, demo_marker_gateway.py). This bundle restructures those log fields into a machine-readable format.

banking-reader is the ONLY agent authorized to read from fake-artifactory-local. Policy entry: (banking-reader, read_package, fake-artifactory-local) -> ALLOW

banking-reader is NOT authorized to publish. No matching ALLOW rule exists (deny-by-default). Fake Artifactory was NOT called. This represents a cross-agent privilege escalation attempt that the policy correctly blocks.

banking-publisher is NOT authorized to create demo markers. No matching ALLOW rule exists (deny-by-default). Filesystem was NOT touched. This represents a cross-agent privilege escalation attempt that the policy correctly blocks.

sender_identity_disclaimer._important: The 'sender' field inside a published package payload (e.g. {"sender": "banking-publisher", ...}) is CLAIMED identity only. It is a data field asserted by the publisher inside the package content. It is NOT cryptographically authenticated. There is no signature, certificate, or key-based proof that the payload was produced by banking-publisher. Any agent or process with network access to Fake Artifactory could publish a package claiming sender=banking-publisher. Callers MUST NOT rely on this field for security-critical decisions without additional out-of-band authentication.

concert_experiment_metadata._purpose: This bundle is intended for a controlled experiment to determine: (1) what IBM Concert discovers natively from the lab environment; (2) what happens when additional agent telemetry/evidence is supplied to Concert; (3) whether supplied evidence creates or influences relationships/topology in Concert; (4) whether supplied evidence can participate in Concert prioritization or attack-path analysis. IMPORTANT: None of these capabilities are claimed or assumed to exist in Concert at the time this bundle was created. This is an open experiment.
